The spread is explained by PSO's 10.60% payout ratio and 0% growth_est_pct depressing the dividend-based DDM method while relative_pe/earnings_power (which don't key off the dividend) run 500-591. composite_fair (402.19) correctly equals the median of the four methods {57.02, 296.67, 507.7, 591.01} = (296.67+507.7)/2 = 402.185, and mispricing_pct (16.5%) = (402.19-345.26)/345.26 = 16.49%, both check out. The room's fa_memo/bear_case/house_view already decompose this explicitly (fa_memo: 'that composite masks a huge spread... DDM says just 57'; bear_case names it as the attack_on_bull), so the wide spread is disclosed to the reader rather than hidden behind the single 'undervalued' headline.
